content:
Hannah Park: Biomend Therapeutics (BMND-58) just pinged — ACH setup failing, Stripe returns 'bank_restricted'. Invoice INV-5120 ($16,250) is past due and they're requesting immediate release of service if we accept a wire. They want next steps ASAP.
Ethan Wu: bank_restricted usually means the receiving bank blocked ACH or the account has limits. Do we have the raw Stripe code? If it's a restriction we should ask for SWIFT/IBAN and consider wire only.
PaymentsBot: ALERT: Payment attempt failed for INV-5120. Error: bank_restricted. Suggested actions: request alternate payment method, or process wire after manual approvals. Created ticket PAY-8244.
Hannah Park: Customer provided bank name Evergreen National (Routing 555000999) and says treasury initiated a same-day wire out. They asked for Redwood's beneficiary + SWIFT ASAP.
Lex Bolton: For wires >$15k we require CFO sign-off + signed payment waiver + confirmation that customer accepts any bank-to-bank fees. Also need to route through our treasury partner to capture trace. Nora, can you confirm?
Nora Li: Confirmed. CFO approval required for amounts above $15k. I can provision a provisional pay path if the customer emails a signed waiver and we get CFO (Marco) ack. Also legal wants a short indemnity clause for cross-border / routing issues.
Ethan Wu: Draft wire instructions ready (will include SWIFT). Hannah, please send these over only after waiver and Marco confirms. Draft payload below: ```
Wire USD 16,250.00
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Inc.
Account: 987654321
Routing: 555000999
Bank: Evergreen National
SWIFT: EVGNUS33
Ref: INV-5120 / BMND-58
```
Hannah Park: Sending draft to customer now with waiver. Customer replied: "We will sign and wire in 30 min, please provide SWIFT & beneficiary details and confirm fees."
PaymentsBot: NOTE: Marking INV-5120 pending manual settlement. Subtask PAY-8244-WIRE created. Please upload waiver and CFO approval to ticket for audit.
Lex Bolton: Also flag this as 'high risk' for revenue recognition until funds trace is received. Treasury will need to verify the originating bank details and provide a trace (MT103) for reconciliation.
Nora Li: I'll escalate to Marco for quick approval. @Marco, please reply in-thread if you authorize one-off wire acceptance for INV-5120 given waiver + customer agreement to fees.
Hannah Park: Marco responded via DM and asked me to forward his approval here: "Marco Ortiz: Approved pending signed waiver on file and legal indemnity clause attached." Forwarded screenshot.
Ethan Wu: Great. Hannah, please upload signed waiver and the Marco screenshot to PAY-8244. Also ask customer to email the bank transfer confirmation/MT103 once they initiate so we can reconcile quickly.
Hannah Park: Done. Sent waiver and requested MT103. Customer replied: "Wire initiated, sender ref 7219-TRX. Will send MT103 when available."
PaymentsBot: UPDATE: Ticket PAY-8244 updated. Reminder set to reconcile once MT103 received. Audit note: CFO approval recorded, legal indemnity attached.
Nora Li: Finance will mark invoice as pending until treasury confirms receipt. Once MT103 arrives, send receipt to billing@redwood.ai for settlement. If trace isn't received within 48 hours, we'll revert to suspended status per policy.
Ethan Wu: I'll monitor treasury queue and post when funds land. Please keep thread open until settled.
Hannah Park: Thanks all — forwarding MT103 when I get it from customer. Marking thread as active until confirmation. :white_check_mark:
